description: File-size ratchet. Files listed here were already over the size-rules.json danger threshold when the gate was introduced; they are allowed to stay, but may only shrink. CI fails if a file not listed here reaches danger, if a listed file grows past its recorded size, if this list grows, or if total excess lines exceed maxExcessLines. Decompose and remove entries — never add them. Run `npm run sizes:baseline` after a decomposition to lower the ceiling.
